''2650'' ([[Postal codes in Denmark|postal code]]) | short name = HIF | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1925|10|15}} | ground = [[Hvidovre Stadion|Pro Ventilation Arena]], [[Hvidovre]] | capacity = 12,000 (4,600 seated) | chairman = Lennart Krimme | manager = [[Martin Retov]] | league = [[Danish 1st Division]] | season = [[2025–26 Danish 1st Division|2025–26]] | position = Danish 1st Division, 5th of 12 | website = {{URL|https://www.hif.dk/}} | pattern_la1 = _uhlsportdivision2rw | pattern_b1 = _uhlsportdivision2rw | pattern_ra1 = _uhlsportdivision2rw | leftarm1 = FF0000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = FF0000 | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _uhlsportdivision2rbw | pattern_b2 = _uhlsportdivision2rbw | pattern_ra2 = _uhlsportdivision2rbw | leftarm2 = 0000FF | body2 = 0000FF | rightarm2 = 0000FF | shorts2 = 0000FF | socks2 = 0000FF }} '''Hvidovre Idrætsforening''', more commonly known as '''Hvidovre IF''' ({{IPA|da|ˈviðˌɒwʁɐ ˌiˀˈef}}) is a [[Football in Denmark|Danish association football club]] from [[Hvidovre]], [[Capital Region of Denmark]]. The club competes in the [[Danish 1st Division]], the second tier of [[Danish football league system|Danish football]], and plays its home matches at the [[Hvidovre Stadion]]. Formed in 1925, the club has been crowned [[List of Danish football champions|Danish champions]] three times, in [[1966 Danish 1st Division|1966]], [[1973 Danish 1st Division|1973]] and [[1981 Danish 1st Division|1981]], and have won the [[Danish Cup]] once, in 1980."}}
